name: Takasu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takasu town emblem in white: a looped ribbon-like device with two upswept ends, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Takasu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1968.

features.role: Takasu town emblem — a looped ribbon-like device with two upswept ends, forming a stylised character
